answer: Reaching eligibility takes 73 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. The bridge register is checked at draw time, dune lists the eligible set, and tundra seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 73 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 140 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
